steps.description: Initial a project inside a folder with name "demo" using databricks asset bundle.
Build bundle configuration from workspace and catalog details (only dev is needed) in specs/databricks_specs folder.
Create python notebooks needed for schema and tables creation as per the specs/schema_specs folder, catalog must exists do not include creation code in the notebooks.
Create python notebooks needed for loading the tables and job resource to orchestrate them as in specs/transformation_specs.

Include data quality quality controls in the transformation python notebooks as per the specs/transformation_specs/data_quality_specs, please use existing `databricks-labs-dqx` library version 0.9.3, refer to the docs in https://databrickslabs.github.io/dqx/, on how to use it (do not create own implementation).

Build AI BI Dashboard resource json(sample json as in specs/dashboard_specs/sample_dashboard.json) as per each dashboard specs in specs/dashboard_specs. Refer to the official document one how to generate dashboard json. once json generated , make sure to refer it in the resources yml. As this is complex task, suggest to use databricks sdk (`databricks-sdk>=0.57.0`) for dashboard json creation.
Must Create proper unit tests for the common utils, should test these utils , do do not create own isolated tests.
Run the unit tests on local spark (create & consider dedicated virtual envrionment and install all the needed libararies including databricks-labs-dqx) and fix if there are any issues.
Also generate script and join to generate and load sample data into bronze tables.
Before deploying the notebooks make sure the transformation code has mapped the target table column data types properly.
Deploy project code and jobs & dashboard resources using databricks cli (bundle) into dev workspace. Must exclude the files to be ignored (e.g. as per .gitignore).
Run the deployed jobs in the correct order.
